subject: Pilot continuity: request for 7-day buffer while procurement & legal finalize
messages:
From: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Rao <pri@medalign.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot continuity: request for 7-day buffer while procurement & legal finalize

Hi Priyanka —

Quick note from our side: I heard procurement and legal are still finalizing the PO and the addendum. We don’t want the integration work and stakeholder demos you’ve scheduled next week to lose momentum. Would MedAlign be open to a short 7-day buffer on the pilot so your team can finish signoff without the environment shutting down?

If helpful, I’ve attached a one-page pilot addendum (pilot-addendum-7day.docx) that documents the temporary extension and the limited-credit allocation — nothing binding beyond keeping the sandbox live for seven days while the PO routes.

Proposed next steps:
- If you confirm, we’ll provision a token grant and lock the trial timer for 7 days immediately.
- We’ll send a DocuSign addendum for internal legal to review.
- If procurement needs more time after the 7 days, we’ll reassess (we’ve handled exceptions like this before).

Dylan, Marissa — can you confirm the token grant amount we can safely provision for this account and any internal approvals needed?

Thanks — looking forward to keeping the demo and integration work uninterrupted.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0192
https://redwood.com

Attachments: SOW-MedAlign-v1.pdf, pilot-addendum-7day.docx

From: Priyanka Rao <pri@medalign.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@medalign.com
Date: 2026-08-25T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot continuity: request for 7-day buffer while procurement & legal finalize

Hi Tessa —

Thank you — this would be a huge help. Procurement routed the PO yesterday but legal is still negotiating a single clause and it looks like approvals will complete early next week. I’ve looped in our legal mailbox so they can expect the DocuSign addendum.

A couple quick asks from procurement:
- Can you confirm the number of test tokens and which models/endpoints will be included under the temporary grant?
- We’ll need a short note stating this is a time-limited, non-billing extension to share with finance.

If you can send the addendum and the formal note, I’ll push procurement to close before the 7 days are up. Appreciate the flexibility — we have a stakeholder demo on Sep 2 and losing access would set things back.

Regards,
Priyanka Rao
Senior PM, Partnerships — MedAlign
pri@medalign.com

Date: 2026-08-26T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot continuity: request for 7-day buffer while procurement & legal finalize

Folks —

I can approve a 7-day trial buffer for MedAlign with the following guardrails:
- Token grant: 120,000 inference tokens allocated to their sandbox.
- Models: includes the Standard-8k and Embedding-v2 endpoints only (no access to larger production variants).
- Monitoring: we’ll enable cost/usage alerts and a hard cap that disables generation if token consumption exceeds the grant.

Marissa — please add a short accounting note that this is a non-billable, temporary extension to be attached to the PO. I’ll log this as an internal exception under DEAL-8242 and push finance sign-off.

Tessa — once you confirm with Priyanka, I’ll provision the grant and send the DocuSign addendum link.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-08-31T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot continuity: request for 7-day buffer while procurement & legal finalize

Hi Priyanka —

Great — we’ll proceed as follows:
1) We will provision a 120,000-token grant to MedAlign’s sandbox right away and lock the timer for 7 days (access window: 2026-08-31 through 2026-09-07).
2) Models covered: Standard-8k (generation) and Embedding-v2 (embeddings) only.
3) This is a temporary, non-billable extension; Marissa has added an accounting note for procurement.
4) I have sent the addendum via DocuSign here: https://www.docusign.com/en/1234-MEDALIGN-ADDENDUM — please route to legal for signature.

Attachment: SOW-MedAlign-v1.pdf (reference only)

If legal signs before Sep 7 we’ll convert to the full contract per the PO; if not, the sandbox will automatically suspend on Sep 7 and we’ll follow up. Let me know if you need the wording tightened for procurement.

Best of luck with the demo — excited to see what your team builds.

Warmly,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0192
